game.name: Samurai Warriors 2 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Samurai Warriors 2 on Xbox 360 is a beat'em all where you can choose from 26 playable characters. Ten new warriors ready to fight appear, among them the unifier of Japan Tokugawa Ieyasu, the legendary Miyamoto Musashi or the mysterious Fûma Kotarô. Battle your way through levels filled with enemies and slaughter every last one of them.
